blogPosts.title: 10 Essential Tips for Marathon Training
blogPosts.excerpt: Preparing for your first marathon? Here are the essential tips every runner should know before starting their training journey.

author.name: Coach Ramesh
author.bio: Professional running coach with 15+ years experience

blogPosts.content:
Marathon training is a journey that requires dedication, patience, and proper planning. Here are the essential tips to help you succeed:

1. Build your base gradually
2. Include cross-training
3. Listen to your body
4. Fuel properly
5. Get adequate rest

Remember, consistency is key to marathon success.
